recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless THO later reintroduces slot/SLOT into CodeSystem/basic-resource-type, in which case the follow-up belongs in the terminology source rather than this core value set wrapper.
issue_request: FHIR-7397 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked to remove or deprecate SLOT / Resource Slot from the Basic Resource Types value set because Slot was already a FHIR resource in the Scheduling/Ordering category; the resolution was to revisit the list and remove duplicates.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 6444, which maps to git commit cddf8c5cdfaa6b3a73584d76f57e7f11aff877ba. That commit, '#7397 - trim basic.resourceType', removed the inline <code value="slot"> Resource Slot concept from source/basic/valueset-basic-resource-type.xml, along with another duplicate concept.
additional_context: Basic is still an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/basic/valueset-basic-resource-type.xml remains in that active resource folder. The value set has since been refactored to import http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/basic-resource-type; the current THO CodeSystem-basic-resource-type JSON lists no slot/SLOT or Resource Slot concept. Later applied issue FHIR-48798 replaced Basic.code's binding with version-independent-resource-types, so current Basic.code behavior is governed by that later R6 decision rather than by the old Basic Resource Types list.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source and imported terminology source already preserve the FHIR-7397 removal, so any source edit would be redundant or outside this core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue replacing Basic.code's binding with version-independent-resource-types; it explains current Basic.code context but was not separately decided here.
